_doc: Known CI failure signatures. classify.py matches a failed job's log (and failed step name) against these. Add a row the first time a NEW failure is understood; the next time it costs seconds. Fields: id, class (see docs/ci/README.md), step (regex on the failed step name, optional), log (regex on the job log, optional), cause, fix, preflight (the local check that catches it, or none), blocking (false = never hold a release).

signatures.cause: MSVC internal compiler error or heap exhaustion on one translation unit; not a diagnostic about our code
signatures.fix: triage.sh names the last-started file; scope /Od to it AND its siblings in one push (ci-failure-triage step 3)
signatures.preflight: none (cannot run MSVC on the Mac)

signatures.cause: A target is missing a source or a library in CMakeLists.txt
signatures.fix: Add the missing library or source to the target; compare with the infinite-vst3-scanner opengl32 fix

signatures.log: undefined reference to|ld: symbol\(s\) not found|Undefined symbols for architecture
signatures.cause: A source file is not in CMakeLists.txt, or a Platform:: function lacks one of its three sides
signatures.fix: Add the source, or write the missing platform side (windows-parity, linux-parity)
signatures.preflight: ibuild.py build catches it on macOS; Linux needs ibuild.py linux

signatures.cause: Code that compiles on this Mac but not on one compiler or standard library (clang vs gcc vs MSVC)
signatures.fix: Fix the exact line named; check windows-parity and linux-parity traps first
signatures.preflight: ibuild.py linux for the Linux half

signatures.cause: A committed golden image no longer matches intended rendering
signatures.fix: If the change is intended: python3 tools/render-check.py --update, review the diff of the PNGs, commit them

signatures.cause: run-infinite-hygiene/driver.sh or headless-tests.sh lists a test that no longer exists or changed its verdict line
signatures.fix: Delete or update the entry in the driver list

signatures.cause: known-test-failures.txt lists a test that passes now (informational line in the driver)
signatures.fix: Delete the listed lines from known-test-failures.txt

signatures.cause: A test failed. If the same test passes on the other compilers, it depends on global state (Transport, singletons, test order) or undefined behaviour, not on the compiler
signatures.fix: Pin the global state inside the test (Feedback 3D: advance the transport per cook); run the group alone with the same env var; use the sanitizers log for UB
signatures.preflight: run the failing INFINITE_<NAME>=1 group locally, also alone

signatures.cause: Memory or undefined-behaviour bug; the log names file and line
signatures.fix: Fix the named line directly; no /Od or flag changes
signatures.preflight: ibuild.py build --mode asan for the one subsystem

signatures.cause: A brand-surface file contains an em dash or off-brand font
signatures.fix: Fix the source (tools/manual/build.py, cards_base.json), rebuild PDFs, rerun pdf_check.py

signatures.cause: A new UI string has no translation in one of the five languages, or lost a format specifier
signatures.fix: python3 tools/i18n/extract.py report; add the missing rows to resources/lang/*.tsv

signatures.cause: A raw colour or widget was added where the design system has a component
signatures.fix: Use the component or token (infinite-design-system); regenerate tokens if tokens.json changed

signatures.cause: A file open that bypasses AppPaths breaks non-ASCII paths on Windows
A dev/debug build was about to be packaged or deployed
signatures.fix: Build with ibuild.py build --mode release (or package.sh); never deploy build-dev

signatures.log: SignPath|Failed to retrieve GitHub App token
signatures.cause: Code signing service or its GitHub App is unavailable (account side)
signatures.fix: Nothing in code. The step is continue-on-error; unsigned binaries still publish. Fix the SignPath account separately

signatures.log: Failed to create deployment|Multiple artifacts named|status: 5\d\d|The operation was canceled|runner has received a shutdown signal
signatures.fix: Check githubstatus.com; start a fresh workflow_dispatch rather than re-running

signatures.log: Could not resolve host|Connection timed out|curl: \(\d+\)|ETIMEDOUT|download.steinberg.net
signatures.cause: A download during configure failed (apt, ASIO SDK, submodule)
signatures.fix: Re-run the job once; if it repeats, check the URL and its pinned hash
